title: Make the IChatProvider seam honest: capabilities carry default model, usage metadata, and error hints
description:
Audit #9, candidate 4 - Worth exploring.

### Problem
The IChatProvider seam is real (Ollama + GitHub Copilot + test fakes) but dishonest: callers branch on the provider's name string. DefaultModelForProvider (ChatServices.cs ~2523) picks config by name; ResolveUsageMetadata (~2561) special-cases 'GitHub' to consult a separate model-metadata list; ChatErrorMessages.Format (~131) branches on name for error text; the ProviderMatches helper is duplicated (lines 149 and 2526). Adding a third provider requires editing three caller branch sites - the interface does not carry the contract.

### Approach
- Widen ChatProviderCapabilities (or equivalent) so each adapter declares: default model resolution, usage-metadata lookup, error-message hints
- Delete the name branches in MemoryChatAgent and ChatErrorMessages; single ProviderMatches helper (or none)
- Out of scope: the council-governed sub-agent provider allowlist in AgentSessionService (session governance, not seam plumbing)

### Acceptance criteria
- No provider-name string comparisons remain outside adapters and the session-governance allowlist
- A hypothetical third adapter requires zero edits in MemoryChatAgent
- Existing provider behavior (default models, GitHub usage metadata, error text) byte-identical; suite green
